clips.title: The story
paras: At Sun Rock Retreat, Maggran Earthbinder guards a Horde camp in the Stonetalon Mountains. Cairne Bloodhoof sent the battle-worn tauren to lead its defense against beasts and harpies.

High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof sent Maggran Earthbinder to the Stonetalon Mountains to lead Sun Rock Retreat. Countless skirmishes and bloody campaigns have hardened his heart, stripping away the gentleness natural to his people. The outpost was also meant to offer him respite, where warm winds and mountain sunshine might ease his battle-worn spirit.

Peace remains scarce in Stonetalon. From Sun Rock Retreat, Maggran coordinates defenses against Bloodfury harpies nesting in the peaks and gathers fighters to face predators across the crags. He once survived an ambush by the giant spider Besseleth, and knows how deadly the wilderness can be. He often enlists travelers to kill regional predators before they overrun the outpost.
